topic.name: 中国与世界
topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: How China Works author on the data economy, robots and AI
items.summary: Lan Xiaohuan is a professor of economics at China Europe International Business School. His book, How China Works: An Introduction to China’s State-led Economic Development, has sold millions of copies in China and has been translated into multiple languages. Here, he discusses the economic realities behind China’s record trade surplus, the case for a stronger social safety net, and how public data infrastructure shapes the artificial intelligence race with the United States. SCMP Plus readers...
items.titleZh: 《中国经济如何运作》作者谈数据经济、机器人与人工智能
items.summaryZh: 中欧国际工商学院教授兰小欢探讨了中国贸易顺差背后的经济现实，以及加强社会保障体系的必要性。他还分析了公共数据基础设施如何影响中国在人工智能领域与美国的竞争。
items.whyImportant: 专家观点为理解中国国家主导的经济发展模式及其在科技竞争中的战略布局提供了深度视角。

items.title: China’s Xi eyes Apec trilateral; no outrunning deadly Nepal floods: SCMP’s 7 highlights
items.summary: We have selected seven stories from this week’s news across Hong Kong, mainland China, the wider Asia region and beyond that resonated with our readers and shed light on topical issues. If you would like to see more of our reporting, please consider subscribing. 1. Xi, Trump and Putin may hold trilateral meeting at next Apec forum, Kremlin says A senior Russian aide suggested on Tuesday that Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin could hold a...
items.titleZh: 中国关注亚太经合组织三方会谈；尼泊尔洪水灾情严重：南华早报七大要闻
items.summaryZh: 本周要闻包括克里姆林宫暗示习近平、特朗普和普京可能在下次亚太经合组织（APEC）论坛期间举行三方会谈。此外，尼泊尔遭遇致命洪水灾害，引发广泛关注。
items.whyImportant: 大国领导人潜在的会晤动向及区域性自然灾害是当前国际政治与社会关注的焦点。

items.title: China’s solar, wind innovations amid rapid green power buildout
items.summary: Even as China installs new solar and wind power capacity faster than the rest of the world combined, it is setting new benchmarks for the technologies through innovation. This year alone, Chinese companies and researchers have generated the first electricity from high-altitude winds 4,000 metres above Earth, cleared the last hurdle to commercialising a cheaper and more efficient alternative to silicon solar panels, begun trials of the world’s most powerful floating and fixed-bottom offshore wind...
items.titleZh: 中国在快速推进绿色能源建设的同时实现太阳能与风能创新
items.summaryZh: 中国在部署太阳能和风能产能方面处于全球领先地位，并不断通过技术创新设定新标准。近期成果包括高空风能发电、新型太阳能电池商业化以及海上风电技术的突破。
items.whyImportant: 中国在可再生能源领域的技术进步正加速全球能源转型进程。

items.title: China stands to gain from US visa restrictions targeting African countries
items.summary: The latest US visa restrictions on citizens of African countries are facing increasing criticism that they are not only punitive but also likely to backfire by driving those nations closer to China. Since August 1, visa services have been suspended in 25 African cities, forcing applicants to travel to other approved locations, sometimes in another country. Travellers from 30 African nations must also post a US$20,000 bond, which is refundable if they depart on time. Separately, 26 countries face...
items.titleZh: 美国针对非洲国家的签证限制措施或使中国受益
items.summaryZh: 美国近期对多个非洲国家实施签证限制，包括暂停签证服务及要求缴纳高额保证金。舆论批评此举具有惩罚性，并可能导致相关国家在外交上进一步向中国靠拢。
items.whyImportant: 美国的外交政策调整可能改变非洲国家与大国之间的地缘政治平衡。

items.title: Cathay Pacific extends Dubai and Riyadh flight suspension through November
items.summary: Hong Kong flag carrier Cathay Pacific Airways has delayed the resumption of passenger flights to Dubai and Riyadh until December at the earliest, extending the suspension of its Middle East services to nine months. The airline attributed the extended postponement to “the latest developments in the Middle East”, with services to both cities now cancelled through November 30. “Affected travellers will be offered the flexibility to rebook, reroute or refund their tickets,” it said. Cathay said it...
items.titleZh: 国泰航空将迪拜和利雅得航班停飞期延长至11月底
items.summaryZh: 受中东地区局势影响，国泰航空决定将往返迪拜和利雅得的客运航班停飞期延长至11月30日。航空公司已为受影响旅客提供改签、更改航线或退款服务。
items.whyImportant: 中东地区的不确定性持续影响国际航空运输网络的正常运行。

items.title: Hong Kong poised to top New York, London in finance-hub ranking: GFCI creator
items.summary: An Asian city will eventually overtake London and New York as the world’s leading financial centre, with Hong Kong well placed to compete for the top spot given its legal predictability and low tax burden, according to the creator of a closely watched ranking of financial hubs. “It’s going to happen because it’s so tight,” said Michael Mainelli, chairman of London-based think tank Z/Yen Group, in an interview with the South China Morning Post on Tuesday, referring to the narrowing gap between...
items.titleZh: 全球金融中心指数创建者：香港有望超越纽约和伦敦
items.summaryZh: Z/Yen集团主席迈克尔·迈内利表示，凭借法律的可预测性和低税收负担，香港在竞争全球金融中心榜首方面处于有利地位。他认为香港最终有望超越伦敦和纽约。
items.whyImportant: 这一观点突显了香港作为国际金融枢纽在复杂全球环境下的竞争力和未来潜力。

items.title: Defendant knew sexual acts with sister as teen ‘seriously wrong’, court told
items.summary: A man who engaged in sexual acts with his younger sister when he was just a teenager knew his behaviour was “seriously wrong”, prosecutors have told Hong Kong’s High Court. Senior Public Prosecutor Karen Ng Ka-yuet said on Thursday that the older sibling, believed to have been aged between 11 and 14 at the time of the alleged offences, was fully aware that the acts involving his sister, three years younger, were inappropriate. The five alleged incidents took place on unspecified dates only weeks...
items.titleZh: 法庭获悉：被告在青少年时期即知晓与妹妹发生性行为是“严重错误”
items.summaryZh: 香港高等法院正在审理一起兄妹性侵案，检方指出被告在案发时虽处于青少年时期，但完全清楚其行为的不当性。案件涉及五起指控，目前正在进一步审理中。
items.whyImportant: 该案件涉及严重的家庭伦理与法律问题，引发了社会对未成年人犯罪及家庭保护的讨论。

items.title: Ecuador’s ex-president and Chinese ambassador seek to avoid jail over belt and road dam
items.summary: Former Ecuadorian president Lenin Moreno and a former Chinese ambassador to Quito asked the country’s highest court on Thursday to spare them the five-year sentences handed down last week over a US$76 million bribery scheme. Moreno was convicted of bribery by a three-judge panel of the National Court of Justice over contracts for Ecuador’s largest hydroelectric project secured by a Chinese state contractor. The judges found unanimously that he had used his position as vice-president, held from...
items.titleZh: 厄瓜多尔前总统及中国前大使寻求推翻“一带一路”大坝项目贿赂案判决
items.summaryZh: 厄瓜多尔前总统莫雷诺及一名前驻厄中国大使因涉及7600万美元的贿赂案被判五年监禁。两人已向最高法院提出上诉，试图推翻此前的有罪判决。
items.whyImportant: 该案件涉及跨国基础设施项目中的腐败指控，对相关国家的政治声誉及双边关系产生影响。

items.title: Australia news live: teenage boys fed misogynistic content within 23 minutes of joining social media, Plibersek says
items.summary: Follow the day’s news live. Every person who’s been rescued or found is a relief to their family and to the broader Australian community. But of course, we still have 36 Australians who are missing and unaccounted for, which is just gut-wrenching for all Australians and for the Nepalese Australian community in particular, whom I’m spending time with later today. But all I can say is that we’re continuing to send any support that the Nepalese government asked for. I think that leaders in the Pacific were deeply concerned: one, that a missile test was done without permission of the countries whose airspace it had travelled through, and two, that there was no notice of the said missile test. So I think it’s both. It is a concern about sovereignty and safety, and one that Australia fully backs. It’s a pretty strong statement, Sally, and one that Australia played a role in crafting. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：普利贝尔塞克称青少年男孩在加入社交媒体23分钟内即被推送厌女内容
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚部长克里斯·鲍文表示，政府将继续支持尼泊尔应对洪灾，目前仍有36名澳大利亚人失踪。此外，政府对近期未经许可的导弹试射表示关切，认为这威胁到了地区主权与安全。
items.whyImportant: 该报道反映了澳大利亚政府在应对国内社交媒体内容监管及国际地缘政治安全问题上的立场。

items.title: Argentina to sanction oil firms as Falklands dispute with UK heats up
items.summary: Javier Milei reiterates his country's claim on the British overseas territory, saying the "winds of change" favour it.
items.titleZh: 阿根廷将制裁石油公司，与英国的福克兰群岛争端升温
items.summaryZh: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱重申了该国对福克兰群岛的主权要求。他表示“变革之风”正有利于阿根廷，并计划对在该地区活动的石油公司实施制裁。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着阿根廷与英国在福克兰群岛主权问题上的外交与经济摩擦进一步加剧。

items.title: EV sales outpace petrol cars for first time as Australians dodge soaring fuel costs
items.summary: New record for Australia as more than 27,000 EVs sold in August, driven by the rising cost of fuel and new government policy Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Electric vehicle sales in Australia exceeded petrol cars for the first time last month as a transformation driven by high fuel prices and government policy encouraging clean car uptake accelerated. More than 27,000 EVs were sold in August, a new record for a single month and representing 24.9% of new cars sold. The climate-friendly technology surpassed both petrol vehicles (nearly 26,000 sold) and diesel cars (23,600). Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 受高油价推动，澳大利亚电动汽车销量首次超过燃油车
items.summaryZh: 受高昂燃油成本和政府清洁能源政策的驱动，澳大利亚8月份电动汽车销量超过2.7万辆，创下历史新高。电动汽车的市场份额首次超过了汽油车和柴油车。
items.whyImportant: 这一数据表明澳大利亚汽车市场正经历向清洁能源转型的关键转折点。

items.title: Molly Ticehurst’s killer called woman he’d met on Tinder after stabbing and said ‘I’m sorry I murdered her’, court hears
items.summary: Daniel Billings said ‘I did what I did’ in call from friend’s house after 2024 domestic violence murder Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Two hours after Daniel Billings murdered his ex-girlfriend Molly Ticehurst in a frenzied stabbing, he spoke to a woman he had met on Tinder. “I’m sorry I murdered her,” Billings told the woman during a phone call at 2.02am on 22 April 2024. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 法庭获悉：莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特的凶手在行凶后致电Tinder结识的女性称“我很抱歉杀了她”
items.summaryZh: 丹尼尔·比林斯在2024年杀害前女友莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特两小时后，致电一名通过Tinder结识的女性并承认了罪行。法庭正在审理这起家庭暴力谋杀案。
items.whyImportant: 该案件的审理细节揭示了凶手在作案后的冷酷行为，引发了公众对家庭暴力问题的广泛关注。

items.title: Hong Kong Nepalese man searches for cousin missing in flood: ‘I cannot sleep’
items.summary: A Hong Kong Nepalese man is searching for his cousin who is missing after the catastrophic flood struck the Himalayan border between Nepal and Tibet. Y.B. Gurung, a 64-year-old retiree, told the South China Morning Post that he last spoke with his tour guide cousin Raju Gurung, 40, at 8am on August 26, shortly before a massive glacial collapse triggered the flash flood that washed away villages and left at least 1,225 people dead. “I cannot sleep every night. I am praying every day that he was...
items.titleZh: 香港尼泊尔裔男子寻找在洪灾中失踪的表亲：“我无法入睡”
items.summaryZh: 一名香港尼泊尔裔男子正在焦急寻找在尼泊尔与西藏边境洪灾中失踪的表亲。该地区发生的冰川崩塌引发了毁灭性洪水，造成大量人员伤亡。
items.whyImportant: 该报道展现了自然灾害对海外侨民家庭造成的深重心理创伤与人道主义影响。

items.title: Moonshot AI – creator of Kimi K3 model – has filed for Hong Kong IPO: sources
items.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence start-up Moonshot AI – developer of the leading Kimi K3 model – has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to two people with knowledge of the matter, as the firm seeks to tap public markets to fund its rapid expansion. The Beijing-based company was targeting a Hong Kong listing as early as the first quarter of 2027, the sources told the South China Morning Post, asking not to be identified as the information was private. The...
items.titleZh: Kimi K3模型开发商月之暗面已秘密提交香港IPO申请
items.summaryZh: 据知情人士透露，中国人工智能初创公司月之暗面已秘密向香港提交首次公开募股（IPO）申请。该公司计划最早于2027年第一季度在港上市，以筹集资金支持其业务的快速扩张。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着中国领先的人工智能企业正积极寻求通过资本市场融资，以在激烈的行业竞争中保持技术研发优势。

items.title: Trump's Iran strategy: Could this become a forever war?
items.summary: The US has launched fresh attacks on military targets in Iran. It wants to prevent Tehran rebuilding its destroyed capabilities, but risks triggering a sustained downward spiral of reconstruction followed by new attacks.
items.titleZh: 特朗普的伊朗战略：这会演变成一场无休止的战争吗？
items.summaryZh: 美国近期对伊朗境内的军事目标发动了新一轮袭击。美方旨在阻止伊朗重建其军事能力，但此举可能引发“重建-再打击”的恶性循环，从而导致长期冲突。
items.whyImportant: 该战略升级引发了国际社会对中东地区陷入长期军事对抗风险的担忧。

items.title: US probes deadly strike on Iran wedding that experts link to US munition
items.summary: US Vice-President J.D. Vance said that the United States ⁠was investigating a deadly strike on an Iranian wedding earlier this week that an analysis published by Reuters showed likely resulted from a direct hit by a US munition. An explosion that ripped through a wedding celebration in southern Iran on Tuesday likely resulted from a direct hit by a US munition and not a ricochet off another target, according to an analysis on Thursday by weapons experts who reviewed images and video verified by...
items.titleZh: 美国调查伊朗婚礼遇袭事件，专家称与美制弹药有关
items.summaryZh: 美国副总统万斯表示，美方正调查近期伊朗一场婚礼遭袭事件。武器专家通过分析图像和视频认为，袭击很可能是由美制弹药直接命中造成的。
items.whyImportant: 若证实美制武器造成平民伤亡，将对美国的外交立场和中东局势产生重大负面影响。

items.title: Milei escalates Argentina’s Falklands dispute with UK as Trump hints at US policy shift
items.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei escalated his country’s dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands on Thursday, vowing new measures to halt an oil project near the British-controlled archipelago and praising US President Donald Trump for saying Washington could reconsider its neutral stance on the islands’ sovereignty. Milei cast Trump’s comments as proof that his close relationship with the US president – criticised by political opponents as overly deferential – was paying dividends. “The...
items.titleZh: 米莱升级阿根廷与英国的马岛争端，特朗普暗示美国政策可能转向
items.summaryZh: 阿根廷总统米莱誓言采取新措施阻止马尔维纳斯群岛附近的石油项目，并赞扬特朗普暗示美国可能重新考虑对该群岛主权的立场。米莱认为，这证明了他与美国总统的密切关系正在产生实际成果。
items.whyImportant: 此举可能加剧阿根廷与英国的外交紧张关系，并标志着美国在马岛主权问题上的立场可能发生重大转变。

items.title: Entertainment over policy? White House arcade games ignite backlash
items.summary: White House arcade games spark criticism for prioritising entertainment amid rising living costs and war concerns.
items.titleZh: 娱乐重于政策？白宫安装街机游戏引发强烈不满
items.summaryZh: 白宫内安装街机游戏的行为引发了批评，公众认为在生活成本上升和战争担忧的背景下，政府应优先处理政策而非娱乐。此举被指责为脱离民众现实需求。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了公众对政府在危机时期优先事项安排的质疑，可能影响政府的舆论形象。

items.title: Nobel laureate Machado: ‘Illegitimate’ Venezuela regime has no right to strike US oil deal
items.summary: Opposition leader says interim government lacking democratic mandate to negotiate on natural resources • The US and Venezuela: a century-old relationship drenched in oil The Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has questioned Donald Trump’s oil deal with Venezuela’s interim government, saying the country’s natural resources do not belong to “an illegitimate regime”. In her first public comments since Trump announced what he called “the biggest oil deal in world history” with Venezuela last Friday, Machado walked a diplomatic tightrope between challenging the agreement and trying not to rile the White House. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 诺贝尔奖得主马查多：委内瑞拉“非法”政权无权签署美国石油协议
items.summaryZh: 委内瑞拉反对派领导人马查多质疑特朗普与该国临时政府达成的石油协议，称自然资源不属于“非法政权”。她在挑战协议的同时，试图在外交上保持谨慎，避免激怒白宫。
items.whyImportant: 马查多的表态凸显了委内瑞拉国内政治合法性争议对国际能源合作协议的潜在阻碍。

items.title: US Vice President JD Vance declines to offer timeline for end of Iran war
items.summary: The Trump official expressed scepticism at White House briefing about the conflict being a war despite recent flare-up.
items.titleZh: 美国副总统万斯拒绝提供伊朗战争结束的时间表
items.summaryZh: 美国副总统万斯在白宫简报会上对伊朗冲突是否属于“战争”表示怀疑，尽管近期冲突有所升级。他拒绝就冲突结束的时间表给出明确答复。
items.whyImportant: 美方对冲突性质的模糊定性可能影响其后续的外交政策走向及对伊朗的军事策略。

items.title: Historic Hong Kong pawn shop gets new lease on life as vibrant community space
items.summary: Inside a pre-war building in the heart of Hong Kong’s busy Wan Chai, coffee, curios and Cantopop are now the fresh attractions breathing new energy into a historic pawn shop that closed its doors two years ago. As the nostalgic tunes of late Cantopop legend Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing spin on vinyl and fill the air, curious passers-by step inside to see the shop – located in the venerable tong lau or tenement building – that has been granted a new lease on life. Built in 1924, the four-storey...
items.titleZh: 香港历史悠久的当铺重获新生，变身为充满活力的社区空间
items.summaryZh: 香港湾仔一栋建于1924年的历史建筑在关闭两年后重新开放，现已转型为融合咖啡、怀旧音乐和文化展示的社区空间。这一举措为老建筑注入了新的活力，吸引了众多市民参观。
items.whyImportant: 该项目展示了香港在城市更新过程中，通过活化历史建筑来保留文化遗产并促进社区发展的尝试。

items.title: Scientists studying cockroach milk and nose-blowing win Ig Nobel prizes
items.summary: Ten research teams were honoured on Thursday at a satirical science awards ceremony that was hosted outside the US for the first time due to travel concerns. Researchers who studied milk from cockroaches and analysed soil health using underwear received Ig Nobel prizes celebrating unusual and imaginative contributions to science. The awards organised by a digital magazine called the Annals of Improbable Research shifted to Europe after 35 years in the US over concerns about attendees being able...
items.titleZh: 研究蟑螂奶和擤鼻涕的科学家获得搞笑诺贝尔奖
items.summaryZh: 第35届搞笑诺贝尔奖首次在欧洲举行，表彰了包括研究蟑螂奶和利用内裤分析土壤健康在内的多项奇特科学研究。该奖项旨在庆祝科学领域中富有想象力和幽默感的贡献。
items.whyImportant: 该奖项通过幽默的方式激发了公众对科学研究的兴趣，并鼓励了跨学科的创新思维。

items.title: Malaysia's middle path between China and US faces new tests
items.summary: The prime minister's comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities near Sabah have revived questions over Malaysia's non-aligned foreign policy.
items.titleZh: 马来西亚在中美之间的中间路线面临新考验
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚总理近期关于台湾问题及美国支持的沙巴附近军事设施的言论，引发了外界对其不结盟外交政策的质疑。马来西亚在中美博弈中维持平衡的难度正在增加。
items.whyImportant: 马来西亚的立场调整可能影响东南亚地区的地缘政治格局及中美在该区域的战略布局。
